subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Leisure activities are activities that people _________ in during their free time while they are not working.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"engage"** means to participate or become involved in an activity. (शामिल होना)

 
 
• **Example: **She likes to engage in different types of crafts during her free time.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that activities that people do in their spare time while they are not working are referred to as leisure activities.
 
• **"Engage"** in this context means to take part in or do an activity.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Encourage** (प्रोत्साहित करना): To give support, confidence, or hope to someone.

 
 
• **Example:** Parents should encourage their children to read books.
 
 
 
• **Evaluate** (मूल्यांकन करना): To judge or determine the significance, worth, or quality of something.
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher will evaluate the students' projects next week.
 
 
 
• **Exempt** (मुक्त करना): Free from an obligation or liability imposed on others.
 
 
• **Example:** The income below the taxable limit is exempt from taxes.
